about: Tip pick-ups, tip ejects and hand touches in the sample clips, found by looking at contact sheets (vision/eval/sheet.py, 0.5 s steps, 0.2 s around unclear moments). Times are seconds into the video, one camera per clip (two views of one moment are two clips). tip_on = the pipette lifts out of the tip box with a tip on. tip_off = the tip leaves the pipette (eject), or, where the eject is off frame, the moment the pipette swings to the waste side. touch = [time, object] when a hand closes on a tube, tube rack, tip box, plate or waste it was not already holding. tip_on and tip_off times start from vision/eval/actions.json; splits are the same as there. touch_labelled says whether touches were looked for in that clip; hand_touch is only scored on clips where they were.
